zh-CN.title: 版本更新交互与提示优化

sections.title: 1.8.2 · 更新入口与布局
items: 优化检查更新相关的样式布局

sections.title: 1.8.0 未发布包说明
items: 1.8.0 没有发布 npm 安装包，但相关功能已正常完成并包含在后续版本中，以下为补充说明

sections.title: 1.8.0 · 默认命令与语言
items: 优化首次使用的默认分类和示例命令，按 Tabby 界面语言初始化，并在升级或重新安装时保留现有命令库

sections.title: 1.8.0 · 数据重置与独立 Dev
items: 新增“重置插件数据”，支持安全清理当前正式版或 Dev 的插件数据并重新初始化
新增可与正式版并存的独立 Dev 版本，以及对应的构建、安装、重启和数据清理命令

sections.title: 1.8.0 · 并发与保存修复
items: 修复正式版与 Dev 同时使用时的快捷键归属和抽屉执行问题
完善数据重置、并发写锁、设置保存以及导入恢复失败时的状态处理

sections.title: 1.8.0 · 本地安装、清理与文档
items: 完善本地安装、卸载、Dev 数据清理和 Tabby 重启流程
同步中英文文档，并补充数据隔离、并发、安装、清理和卸载测试

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。普通升级不会清空已有命令库；“重置插件数据”和 Dev 清理不可撤销，请先导出需要保留的命令和配置。

en.title: Update interaction and notification improvements

sections.title: 1.8.2 · Update entry points and layout
items: Improve the styling and layout of update checks

sections.title: Unpublished 1.8.0 package
items: No npm installation package was published for 1.8.0, but its changes were completed normally and remain included in later versions; the following is a supplemental summary

sections.title: 1.8.0 · Default commands and language
items: Improve the initial default category and example command, initialize them in Tabby's interface language, and preserve existing command libraries during upgrades or reinstalls

sections.title: 1.8.0 · Data reset and separate Dev builds
items: Add Reset plugin data to safely clear and reinitialize data for the selected stable or Dev version
Add a separate Dev version that can coexist with stable, with commands for building, installation, restart, and data cleanup

sections.title: 1.8.0 · Concurrency and saving fixes
items: Fix shortcut ownership and drawer execution when stable and Dev are used together
Improve state handling for data reset, concurrent write locks, settings saves, and failed imports or restores

sections.title: 1.8.0 · Local installation, cleanup, and documentation
items: Improve local installation, uninstall, Dev data cleanup, and Tabby restart workflows
Synchronize the Chinese and English documentation and add tests for data isolation, concurrency, installation, cleanup, and uninstall

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Normal upgrades preserve existing command libraries. Reset plugin data and Dev cleanup cannot be undone; export any commands and configuration you need to keep first.
